_comment: cc-P182: the web console's Golem buttons. One file, read by web-console/server.py (what the page shows, the word it asks for, the inputs it passes) and by Get-WebActionPlan in scripts/Shard-Console.ps1 (the console action each one runs, and the word checked again before Invoke-Plan). action is a Shard Console action key (Get-ActionPlan); word is what must be typed (case ignored, phones capitalize): a fixed word, '#prompt' (the prompt picked, P<nn>) or '#stopped' (the STOPPED prompt, as the console's plan names it). when: the Golem must be in that state now (winding:<w>, notWinding:<w>, nightShift:on|off, runNext:set; cc-P200 marathonNot:<mode>, settings.json marathon is not that mode). fixed: inputs the button always passes (cc-P200: the marathon mode). disabled: shown greyed with that reason, refused by the server. card (cc-P208): 'merge' puts the button on Shadow Iron's card (the merge Golem; settings.json mergeGolem) instead of the Controls (Merge now stays on the Controls while there is no such card); when mergePaused:on|off is its pause. anyGolem (cc-P186): the button is on every Golem's card too (another Golem on this PC runs it through the same runner with -Golem <name>; a Golem on another PC gets it through its agent, Remote-Agent.ps1); without it, it is the integrator's only. golemWord (cc-P187): for another Golem than the integrator the word is this and the Golem's name ('wake bronze'; '#prompt' or '#stopped' is the prompt and the name, 'P130 bronze'), so the typed confirm names the Golem it acts on. cc-P187 also: Self-wake (when autoWake:on|off), Check CLI sign-in, Send test email, and Assign ('#assign': the plan's phrase, 'P130 on bronze'; inputs prompt, assignTo and next), which writes the prompt's **Golem:** line for the Golem picked on the page. Turn on and Rest are a Golem's resume and pause of its lane. art: the button's slot in scripts/console-art (a drawn stand-in until it lands). ASCII only.

actions.label: Poke the Golem
actions.help: Opens a new Claude Code session on the game PC on the picked model; it says the start phrase and the Golem hands it the next prompt.

actions.label: Turn on
actions.help: Turns the Golem on (ENABLED). Wake needs it on.

actions.label: Poke
actions.help: Runs the Golem's 10-minute watch now: it looks again at a stall, a rest whose time has come, a pending wake.

actions.label: Rest
actions.help: Rests the Golem now: nothing more is handed on; a running prompt finishes but is not committed.

actions.label: Wrap up after this task
actions.help: The running prompt goes to DONE, is committed and pushed, then the Golem rests (ENABLED kept).

actions.label: Cancel wrap up
actions.help: The queue goes on after the running prompt.

actions.label: Find a stopping point
actions.help: CC finishes its step, leaves both repos green, writes a continuation prompt and ends PAUSED; then the Golem commits and rests.

actions.label: Cancel stopping point
actions.help: Undone if CC has not been told yet; once told, it still ends PAUSED.

actions.label: Long run
actions.help: Up to the cap (a number, or all) until the end time, then back to maxPerRun by itself.

actions.label: End long run
actions.help: maxPerRun counts again from the next hand-off.

actions.label: Night shift on
actions.help: A scheduled task wakes the Golem for a long run between the two times, when the queue, the state and the usage allow.

actions.label: Night shift off
actions.help: The scheduled task Golem Night Shift is removed.

actions.label: Run next
actions.help: The picked queued prompt goes first at the next hand-off. Nothing is renamed.

actions.label: Clear Run next
actions.help: The queue goes in its own order again.

actions.label: Retry stopped prompt
actions.help: The STOPPED prompt goes back into the queue, first, and a session is woken on its own model.

actions.label: Merge now
actions.help: cc-P184: the integrator merges every finished Golem branch into main now, one at a time; a conflict or a red build becomes a fix-up prompt. Nothing while a prompt runs on it, its trees are dirty, or multiGolem is off. cc-P208: with Shadow Iron (settings.json mergeGolem) it runs one of Shadow Iron's rounds now, and sits on its card.

actions.label: Pause merging
actions.help: cc-P208: Shadow Iron runs no merge round until Resume; finished branches wait in merge-queue.

actions.label: Resume merging
actions.help: cc-P208: Shadow Iron merges again: one round now, then every 10 minutes.

actions.label: Assign to the picked Golem
actions.help: cc-P187: the picked queued prompt gets the line **Golem:** <that Golem>, so only that Golem claims it; with Run it next, it also goes first for that Golem. Refused with the reason when the Golem's lane, areas or the prompt's Touches cannot take it.

actions.label: Self-wake on
actions.help: After a context rest, a model wait or the run cap the Golem opens the next CC session itself (within settings.json's limits).

actions.label: Self-wake off
actions.help: The Golem rests and emails instead; you open the next session.

actions.label: Marathon on
actions.help: cc-P200: marathon now, whatever the projection says: every awake Golem woken on its lane, no rest after a Large prompt, no run cap, the night shift at full, the extra PCs also in the day (their back-off still holds). The 5-hour window still holds.

actions.label: Marathon auto
actions.help: cc-P200: the default. On when the week's projection falls short of 95% with more than 6 hours left; off at 95% or at usageLimitPct. Each switch is emailed once.

actions.label: Marathon off
actions.help: cc-P200: never marathon: the Golems pace themselves as before, whatever the projection says.

actions.label: Check CLI sign-in
actions.help: Runs claude auth status and records the answer in cli.json for the Golem and both consoles. Changes nothing else.

actions.label: Send test email
actions.help: Send-TestEmail.ps1 sends one email to the address in email.json the way the hook does, and prints sent or the error.

actions.label: Away mode on
actions.help: cc-P149: until the time given, the Golems work around the clock within the night shift's usage rule, park a prompt that stops for a decision and go on, and email a digest each morning. Reply to any Golem email with a command (status, resume, away off, ...).

actions.label: Away mode off
actions.help: cc-P149: the Golems go back to their usual pace and rests; parked prompts stay parked (the Golem page lists them).
